about: ~*~ Welcome, traveler! ~*~ You are visitor number 004,218 to this profile! (I am keeping count by hand, since OurSpace has no hit counter. I have written to Todd.) My name is Angela and I am the Webmistress of Angela's Enchanted Realm, an Angelfire site I have been building since I was 10. It has two shrines (Vulpix and Legolas), a third shrine that is a SECRET, a webring, an awards page, a rippling lake, and a guestbook with 214 entries. It is UNDER CONSTRUCTION and always has been, because a good site is never finished! This profile is only my satellite page. My REAL home on the web is the Realm. Best viewed at 800x600. Please sign my guestbook before you leave!
aboutMore: ~ About the Webmistress ~ My dad taught me my first tag out of a library book on a Saturday when I was 10. It was the CENTER tag and I have centered everything since. I have updated the Realm every single day for seven years, even if it is only one word, which is why the 'Last Updated' date is always today. I never delete a page. A Webmistress does not delete, she ARCHIVES. The Vulpix shrine still has my spelling from fifth grade ('Vulpix is the most beatiful pokemon') and it is staying.
meet: Who I'd Like to Meet: Everyone who has ever signed my guestbook, to thank them in person (I already thank each one by e-mail). Whoever owns the two broken sites in my webring, to ask if they are okay. Legolas. A Vulpix. And the little man on the 'Under Construction' sign. He has been digging on my site for seven years and I would like to tell him he can take a break.

interests.General: HTML (hand-typed in Notepad!), frames, tables, hit counters, guestbooks (signing them AND having one), webrings, site awards (giving and receiving), animated gifs, MIDI files, sparkle cursors, adoptable pixel dragons, updating my site every day, centering things

interests.Movies: The Lord of the Rings (extended editions; I have 340 Legolas screen captures, sorted by braid), The Princess Bride, Ever After, Pokemon: The First Movie (I cried; there is a page about it), Ella Enchanted, Spirited Away

interests.Heroes: My dad (taught me the CENTER tag), Legolas, the Under Construction man, everyone who signs a guestbook honestly, Nat (youngest winner of my Cool Site Award), Todd (a fellow webmaster; his Server Status Page is charming)

blog.title: ~ What's New: The Saturday I Learned CENTER ~
blog.body: A visitor asked how the Realm began, so here is the story for my archives! When I was 10 I wanted a web page about Vulpix more than I wanted anything. My dad did not know how to make one either. So we went to the library and checked out a book called HTML for the World Wide Web, and on a Saturday we sat at the family computer with the book open between us. The first thing we typed was my name. It showed up small, in the top left corner, like it was hiding. Then Dad found the CENTER tag. We typed it, pressed refresh, and my name jumped to the middle of the screen. I screamed. He high-fived me so hard the mouse fell off the desk. We added a green background, purple words, and a Vulpix that took four minutes to load. That page is still up. I have changed something on the site every day since, and every month he signs the guestbook. Under 'How did you find my site?' he writes, 'I was there.'

blog.title: ~ Cool Site Award: Why There Are Only Four ~
blog.body: People ask why Angela's Cool Site Award is so hard to win. It is a spinning star, 120 pixels wide, and I made it when I was 11. In seven years I have given it four times! 1) My dad's bowling league page. He posts the scores every Thursday night and has never missed one. 2) A site about lighthouses, by a retired gentleman in Maine. The site is gone now. The award outlived it. I keep the link. 3) Nat's guild page: tidy tables, a marquee at the correct speed, and she is only 14. 4) Todd's Server Status Page, for honesty. What do they have in common? Not beauty. Nick's cartoons are flashier and Liz's layouts are fancier. The winners all have someone HOME. You can feel a person in there, checking on things, moving a comma. That is the whole test. Current nominees: malten (promising!) and Marcus (no). Doug's page is plain gray with nothing on it, and somehow he is the closest to a fifth.

survey.title: ~*~ The Webmistress Survey! ~*~ (Please sign the guestbook after reading!)
qa: Name and title:
Angela, Webmistress and Ringmistress (two separate jobs!)
Name of your site:
Angela's Enchanted Realm. It was 'Angela's Vulpix Page' until I was 13.
How long has it been under construction?
Seven years! The little digging man has not rested once.
Number of guestbook entries:
214! I can name every signer. Three of them are watches.
Best viewed in:
800x600, with the sound ON, on a connection faster than Doug's (sorry, Doug!)
Awards you have won:
31! Including 'Kewl Site of the Week' from a site that no longer exists, and 'Best Lake' (I made that one myself, but it was true).
Favorite HTML tag:
CENTER. Then MARQUEE. Then BLINK, in moderation.
Something on your site nobody has found yet:
There is a secret page. You have to click the third star from the left. In seven years one person has found it. It was my dad. I had told him.
Biggest webmistress fear:
A visitor leaving without signing the guestbook. Also Angelfire going away someday. I do not think about that one.
Message to your visitors:
Thank you for stopping by! Please come again! The site will be different tomorrow, by at least one comma.
